WITH revenue AS (
  SELECT
    o.tenant_id,
    SUM(
      o.grand_total / CASE WHEN o.currency_code = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE er.rate END
    ) AS revenue_eur
  FROM orders o
  LEFT JOIN exchange_rates er
    ON er.base_code = 'EUR'
    AND er.quote_code = o.currency_code
    AND er.as_of = CAST(o.placed_at AS date)
  WHERE o.placed_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND o.placed_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
  GROUP BY o.tenant_id
),
top50 AS (
  SELECT tenant_id, revenue_eur,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY revenue_eur DESC) AS rn
  FROM revenue
),
product_stats AS (
  SELECT
    p.tenant_id,
    p.id AS product_id,
    COUNT(pr.id) AS review_count,
    AVG(pr.rating) AS avg_rating
  FROM products p
  JOIN product_reviews pr
    ON pr.product_id = p.id
    AND pr.is_approved = true
  GROUP BY p.tenant_id, p.id
  HAVING COUNT(pr.id) >= 5
),
merchant_agg AS (
  SELECT
    tenant_id,
    COUNT(*) AS products_with_5plus_reviews,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE avg_rating < 3.0) AS poor_rated_product_count
  FROM product_stats
  GROUP BY tenant_id
)
SELECT
  t.name AS merchant_name,
  t.industry,
  COALESCE(ma.products_with_5plus_reviews, 0) AS products_with_5plus_reviews,
  COALESCE(ma.poor_rated_product_count, 0) AS poor_rated_product_count,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(ma.products_with_5plus_reviews, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(ma.poor_rated_product_count::numeric / ma.products_with_5plus_reviews * 100, 1)
  END AS pct_poor_rated_products,
  ROUND(r.revenue_eur, 2) AS revenue_eur_last_12mo
FROM top50 r
JOIN tenants t ON t.id = r.tenant_id
LEFT JOIN merchant_agg ma ON ma.tenant_id = r.tenant_id
WHERE r.rn <= 50
ORDER BY
  poor_rated_product_count DESC,
  pct_poor_rated_products DESC NULLS LAST,
  merchant_name
note: Top-50 set is independently re-derived here using the same revenue definition (orders placed 2025-01-01..2025-12-31, non-cancelled, converted to EUR via exchange_rates as of placed_at) rather than joining to a stored Merchant Catalog Profile output, so results should match that report's top-50 as long as its revenue logic is identical. Returns at most 50 rows (one per top-50 merchant); merchants with zero products having 5+ approved reviews show pct_poor_rated_products as blank/NULL.
